description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Information' controller class for the admin catalog module of an OpenCart project. The class manages CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, and other administrative functions for information entries within the catalog.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class handling administrative management of catalog information entries in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main information listing page with filters for store, language, status, and navigation links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to generate the list view of information entries.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and renders a paginated list of information entries based on filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an information entry, including loading related data such as descriptions, layouts, SEO URLs, and stores.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating information entries, with validation for permissions, title length, and SEO URL correctness.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected information entries by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected information entries by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected information entries, with checks to prevent deletion of core store pages or linked store entries.
